label: Zero Depreciation
definition: In case of a claim, the insurer pays the full replacement cost of damaged parts without deducting depreciation for their age. This is NOT the same as a deductible.

label: NCB Protection
definition: An add-on that preserves your No Claim Bonus discount even if you file one claim in the policy year.

label: No Claim Bonus (NCB)
definition: A discount on premium, usually 20 to 50 percent, given at renewal for each consecutive year you do not file a claim.

label: Insured Declared Value (IDV)
definition: The maximum amount the insurer will pay if the vehicle is stolen or declared a total loss -- roughly the vehicle's current market value.

label: Third-Party Cover
definition: Mandatory-by-law cover that pays for injury or damage the insured vehicle causes to OTHER people or property. It does not pay for damage to the insured's own vehicle.

label: Own Damage Cover
definition: Cover for damage to the POLICYHOLDER's own vehicle from accidents, theft, fire, or natural calamities. Combined with third-party cover, this makes a Comprehensive policy.

label: Roadside Assistance (RSA)
definition: Add-on cover for breakdown help such as towing, flat tyre change, fuel delivery, or minor on-the-spot repairs.

label: Engine Protection
definition: Add-on covering engine damage from water ingress (flooding) or oil leakage, which standard policies usually exclude.

label: Consumables Cover
definition: Add-on covering consumable items used during repair (engine oil, nuts, bolts, grease) that are normally excluded from claims.

label: Return to Invoice (RTI)
definition: Add-on that pays the original purchase invoice price of the vehicle, not just the depreciated IDV, if it is stolen or a total loss.

label: Passenger Cover
definition: Extends personal-accident-style cover to passengers in the vehicle, not just the owner-driver.

label: Personal Accident Cover
definition: Covers death or permanent disability of the owner-driver caused by a road accident.

label: EV Battery Cover
definition: Add-on specific to electric vehicles covering damage to the vehicle's battery.

label: Telematics-Based Insurance
definition: Insurance where a device or app tracks driving behaviour (speed, braking, distance) to offer discounts for safe driving.

label: Cashless Garage
definition: A garage with a direct billing tie-up with the insurer, so the policyholder does not pay upfront -- the insurer settles the bill directly with the garage.
